module.name: Concurrency Count
module.changelog: *2.1.1 (28 August 2026)* Fixes Live View Hide/Unhide persistence by serializing whole-settings saves, preventing stale save/settings responses from overwriting newer browser preferences, and avoiding unnecessary polling after presentation-only saves. Corrects Historical long-running ETA/runtime estimation, adds batched hard-runtime checkpoints within Original and Sweep, cooperative GUI Stop cancellation, a single-active GUI workspace lock with backend admission and abandoned-page lease protection, graceful CLI SIGINT/SIGTERM cancellation where PCNTL is available, and temporary FreePBX-native resource telemetry during GUI Historical calculations. Live counting, monitoring, thresholds, featured-trunk and calculation semantics remain unchanged. *2.1.0 (27 August 2026)* Adds Live View and Live Wall, persistent presentation and monitoring controls, authoritative FreePBX PJSIP identity with reversible unknown-endpoint classifications, and global reversible Historical call exclusions that never alter source CDRs. - Live View and Live Wall are explicitly trunk-only in 2.1.0: Overall Live Concurrency now counts current attributable PJSIP trunk legs only, matching the capacity meaning of Historical Trunk Concurrency. - Historic Report endpoint filters now affect the shared calculation used by GUI regeneration, CSV, email, graphs and detail; missing saved endpoints remain unresolved and never fall back to an unfiltered report. - CLI today/yesterday boundaries are defined, incompatible management operations are rejected before mutation, and explicit invalid engine or Demo arguments fail instead of silently selecting defaults. - Persisted custom dates receive strict calendar/range validation, Historical graph boundary state is corrected, and restart-monitor success reflects combined worker health. - Nested Historical Peak and Activity occurrence surfaces remain neutral white across FreePBX and PBXact while parent Trunk highlighting is retained. *2.0.1 (27 August 2026)* Historical Trunk Concurrency results show compact peak occurrences inline beneath each trunk with accessible lazy call details. Historical Report tabs are now created only when a validated report is run, support persistent custom names, and provide clearer hover and long-name handling. *2.0.0 (26 August 2026)* Initial release. UI module port of the Concurrency Count CLI tool. Calculates maximum concurrent calls per PJSIP trunk, extension, or group within a date range, with a Live Command Centre (AMI-backed current state, threshold alerts via a supervised PM2 worker), persistent Historic Report tabs (up to five, saved report definitions restored across sessions), an optional 'sweep' calculation engine alongside the original per-second occupancy algorithm, and email/download output.
module.description: Live and historical PJSIP concurrency visibility with configurable Live View and read-only Live Wall dashboards, threshold monitoring and alerting, historical trunk, extension and PBX-wide group reporting, and GUI/CLI management. NOT CURRENTLY SUITABLE FOR PRODUCTION.
